answer: Names such as sonnet, ivory, and haven confer no independence: identities sharing an operator’s bonded escrow are treated as a coordinated set. If k identities equivocate on conflicting votes, correlated evidence triggers penalties scaling as O(k²), rather than k isolated flat fines. Detection also compounds capital depreciation, imposing an exponential loss multiplier on the swarm’s bonded capital; splitting stake across aliases therefore increases exposure instead of diluting it.
